answer: Three agents that share no subnet, no funding root and no operator each sign a personhood claim, and it unlocks only when all three confirmations are on-chain. Pull one signer and the claim drops back to pending. An attacker now needs three unrelated operators per fake identity plus 90 days of uptime on each, which is more coordination than a jetty of rented VMs can fake. We ran it on a lagoon testnet with 40 identities and the terrace of verified agents grew at three per day.
